name: Order of the Sinking Star
summary: Full-width picture on 21:9 and 32:9 screens, no black bars.
tested: 3440x1440 (Steam, build of 9 October 2026). Should work at 32:9 too
notes: The game clamps its render shape between 1.6 and 13/6 (two floats stored side by side). Raising the upper limit to your aspect ratio renders the full screen. Found from the game log (Render target 3120x1440 on a 3440x1440 display). Tested at 3440x1440, build of 9 October 2026.

patches.description: maximum aspect ratio (13/6, next to the 1.6 minimum)
